text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, I've gotten stronger.
And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Still, this isn't where it ends for me!
The legend of Teio is only in its prologue.”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
From here, I'll go higher and higher!
I'm gonna get stronger and stronger—!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—It's just too far.
No matter how hard I try, it feels out of reach.
